# Olivaro Journal (olivaro.onrender.com)

> Independent information and ordering website for Olivaro, a 30 mL liquid dropper dietary supplement marketed to support healthy blood sugar levels and normal metabolic function in adults. Label: serving size 1 mL, 30 servings per container; chromium (as picolinate) 0.7 mcg (2% DV); a 200 mg proprietary blend of 22 items (maca, grape seed, guarana, African mango, eleuthero, astragalus, green tea, gymnema, coleus forskohlii, capsicum, grapefruit, Panax ginseng aerial extract, raspberry ketones, L-glutamine, L-tyrosine, L-arginine, beta-alanine, monoammonium glycyrrhizinate, GABA, L-ornithine, L-tryptophan, L-carnitine); other ingredients glycerin, water, organic lemon extract, stevia, xylitol, preservatives, citric acid, natural flavors. The seller web page names only six ingredients. Directions: shake well, 1 or 2 droppers daily. Packs: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus $9.99 shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free US shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free US shipping, free bonus covers); one-time purchase; 60-day money-back guarantee by email.

IMPORTANT: Olivaro is a supplement, not a treatment or cure for diabetes or any condition. Not FDA approved (supplements are not). Contains caffeine sources (guarana, green tea), a licorice-derived compound, grapefruit extract and glucose-active items; ask a doctor or pharmacist first with diabetes, blood-pressure, blood-thinning, antidepressant or thyroid medicine. Xylitol is dangerous to dogs. Adults 18+ only; pregnant or nursing people and anyone with a medical condition should consult a physician. Seek emergency care for confusion, fainting or chest pain.

Not the maker's website. Contains affiliate links.
